decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the $18 commission, missing-or-rejected trigger, random NFT owner recipient, and expanded invalid-referral scope.
A same-message MODIFY already incorporates the accepted-referral and missing-or-rejected-referral rules into the relevant FAQ content.
A complete same-message MODIFY already replaces the old Small Block ticket allocation with one $2,000 drawing entry for an accepted referral.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records the $25 credit for the chosen referrer when a referral is accepted.

The existing About-page copy describes only the continuing $900 prize mechanics and may become incomplete after introduction of the $2,000 accepted-referral drawing, but message 305 explicitly targets the referral popup and does not clearly authorize About-page revisions.
The source changes referral reward allocation but does not change whether active entries, referral identity, badges, or book access follow an NFT transfer.
The checkout-confirmation rule constrains referral validity but does not change the token serial as the referral identifier or any display location.
The source specifies who receives draw entries and under which referral outcomes, but it does not change Small Block entry eligibility, expiration, burning, reset, or carry-forward behavior.
The source reiterates the existing rule that only NFTs confirmed before checkout are valid and establishes no new validation state.
The source changes reward amounts and recipients but says nothing about automatic wallet transfer, manual claiming, or claim controls.
Assigning one $900 draw entry for a missing or rejected referral does not change the Small Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, pool funding, or eligibility mechanism.

The landing page still promotes $10 accepted-referral commissions and entries into the $900 draw, which may conflict with the new conditional rewards, but the source explicitly targets popup behavior and does not specify replacement landing-page copy.
